usage: ai-effort-ledger entry add [--store FOLDER] [--json] [--language {en,it}] [-h]
                                  --from INSTANT --to INSTANT --mode {overlapping,additional}
                                  [--project PROJECT] [--work-item WORK ITEM] [--note TEXT]

write a manual entry

options:
  --store FOLDER                   use another store folder for this command only
  --json                           write the result as one JSON document
  --language {en,it}               the language of the output
  -h, --help                       show this help message and exit
  --from INSTANT                   the start of the interval
  --to INSTANT                     the end of the interval
  --mode {overlapping,additional}  how the entry meets the measured human time
  --project PROJECT                the project, as its identifier or its name
  --work-item WORK ITEM            the work item, as its identifier or its name
  --note TEXT                      a note for the event or for the report
